subject.title: feat(gateway): add context engine control API

question: Should OpenClaw expose context-engine status, doctor, and rotate as a core Gateway/plugin control API once the session-targeting bug is fixed?
rationale: The PR creates a new public Gateway surface and optional ContextEngine plugin contract, which is a product/API boundary decision beyond the mechanical scoping defect.

options.title: Approve after scoping fix
options.body: Keep the API direction, but require canonical session targeting, focused regression tests, and maintainer-reviewed docs/scope semantics before merge.

options.title: Narrow to read-only control
options.body: Land only capabilities/status/doctor first and revisit admin rotate after a separate owner decision.

options.title: Defer to plugin-owned control
options.body: Pause or close this core PR until a broader Gateway control-plane contract is designed.

recommendation.title: Approve after scoping fix
recommendation.body: Keep the API direction, but require canonical session targeting, focused regression tests, and maintainer-reviewed docs/scope semantics before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Gateway session-control and operator-scope work makes this the best available routing signal for the API decision.
